Turn search into measurable mission impact.

A clearer starting point

An opportunity your team can put to work.

Small and midsized nonprofit teams often have limited time and no dedicated digital marketing department. We simplify the next step.

  1. 01

    Discover the grant

    You may not know the program exists or whether your organization qualifies. Start with a practical eligibility and readiness screen.

  2. 02

    Activate what you already have

    An existing grant needs relevant campaigns, useful destination pages and a clear path for supporters to act.

  3. 03

    Make the whole journey work

    Search traffic needs a website and measurement system that connect attention to donations, volunteer inquiries and registrations.

From readiness to impact

Five steps. One connected journey.

  1. 01

    Assess

    Determine basic eligibility, Google for Nonprofits status, website readiness and your primary mission goal.

  2. 02

    Prepare

    Resolve website, landing-page, tracking or conversion gaps where needed, with priorities based on your actual situation.

  3. 03

    Launch

    Support activation and build mission-focused campaigns around relevant searches and meaningful actions.

  4. 04

    Grow

    Monitor campaigns, review search terms, test ads and improve the supporter journey.

  5. 05

    Measure

    Connect campaign performance to completed actions and explain what those outcomes mean for your mission.

Why EVOBRAND

Connect the campaign to the whole experience.

Advertising + Web Technology + UX + Analytics + Automation + AI. We can support the full conversion journey, from a search to a completed mission action.

A campaign may need clearer content, a better donation funnel, an accessible mobile experience, a dedicated landing page or reliable tracking. We can also connect CRM workflows and use AI automation to support timely follow-up. Recommendations start with observed or reported gaps and your organization’s priorities.

Measure what matters

Count the actions. Understand the impact.

Reporting should help your leadership team make decisions about the mission, beyond advertising activity.

  • Donors
  • Volunteer inquiries
  • Program participants
  • Event registrations
  • Members & email supporters
  • Community awareness

Reports connect mission-aligned visits to completed actions, highlight where supporters drop off and recommend the next improvement. Awareness is considered alongside engagement and mission goals. These are reporting goals, not promised results.

Frequently asked questions

Understand the program. Choose your next step.

Google Ad Grants gives eligible nonprofits access to up to $10,000 per month in Google Search advertising to help people discover their mission. It is an advertising benefit, not a cash grant.

EVOBRAND is an independent service provider and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Google. Program policies can change. Review Google’s Ad Grants FAQ, eligibility guidelines and website policy. Guidance reviewed October 5, 2026.
